title: Sherpa voice ASR — download model then exercise via testASR
description: Generic flow: takes the model id (param0), the testASR alias (param1), and optional language (param2). Triggers downloadModel via the bridge, polls until status === 'downloaded' (cap 30 min), then runs the testASR roundtrip.

download.expression: (function(){var A=globalThis.__AGENTIC__;if(!A||!A.downloadModel||!A.getState){return Promise.resolve({status:'error',error:'agentic bridge missing downloadModel/getState'});}var MODEL_ID='{{params.modelId}}';function modelStatus(){var s=(A.getState().models||{}).statuses||{};return (s[MODEL_ID]||{}).status||'unknown';}if(modelStatus()==='downloaded'){return Promise.resolve({status:'success',already:true});}try{A.downloadModel(MODEL_ID);}catch(e){}return new Promise(function(resolve){var i=0;function tick(){if(modelStatus()==='downloaded'){resolve({status:'success'});return;}i++;if(i>=3600){resolve({status:'timeout',lastStatus:modelStatus()});return;}setTimeout(tick,500);}tick();});})()

fire-asr.expression: (function(){var A=globalThis.__AGENTIC__;if(!A||!A.testASR||!A.getLastResult){return Promise.resolve({status:'error',error:'agentic bridge missing testASR/getLastResult'});}A.testASR('{{params.alias}}',undefined,'{{params.language}}');return new Promise(function(resolve){var i=0;function tick(){var r=A.getLastResult();if(r&&r.op==='asrTest'&&r.status!=='pending'){resolve(r);return;}i++;if(i>=120){resolve({status:'timeout'});return;}setTimeout(tick,500);}tick();});})()

prepare-ready-0.intent: The sherpa-voice app is running with the agentic bridge installed.
